scripts.build: bun run --filter @tasks/domain build && bun run --filter @tasks/application build && bun run --filter @tasks/workspace build && bun run --filter @tasks/surface build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run --filter @tasks/domain build && bun run --filter @tasks/application build && bun run --filter @tasks/workspace build && bun run --filter @tasks/surface build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && cd ../.. && bun test --timeout 15000 packages/web/test
